label: Bible Study
prompt: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be _____ from the body, and to be present with the Lord.
verse: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.
note: Paul's confident hope — away from the body means at home with the Lord.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Some trust in _____, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.
verse: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.
note: Some trust in chariots and some in horses; David's people bring something better — the name of the LORD.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And a _____ was brought, and laid upon the mouth of the den; and the king sealed it with his own signet, and with the signet of his lords; that the purpose might not be changed concerning Daniel.
verse: And a stone was brought, and laid upon the mouth of the den; and the king sealed it with his own signet, and with the signet of his lords; that the purpose might not be changed concerning Daniel.
note: A stone sealed with the king's own signet covered the lions' den — so no one could change the outcome.

label: Deep Water
prompt: The stone which the builders _____ is become the head stone of the corner.
verse: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.
note: Jesus quotes this after the parable of the tenants — the rejected stone became the cornerstone.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Wherefore doth a living man _____, a man for the punishment of his sins?
verse: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
note: The same chapter that sings 'great is thy faithfulness' asks why a living man should 'complain' about the punishment of his sins.
